items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Fleet-wide clearance is unsupported because fleet-doctor reports ok=false with no run, operations deploy/uptime/error sweeps have no results, and authentication boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, incident signals, and disclosure readiness are not evidenced. Compliance provides technical HTTPS evidence for 37 passing sites, but does not establish fleet security. Exact decision: keep security-sensitive exposure, new public launches, monetization expansion, credential/configuration changes, dependency additions, and production deployments gated; permit ordinary reversible no-credential, no-permission, no-dependency, no-configuration, no-tracking growth that preserves existing disclosures and data boundaries.
